nodes.name: Validate NASA Response

parameters.jsCode: const feed=$input.first().json;if(!feed?.near_earth_objects)throw new Error('NASA response missing near_earth_objects');const candidates=Object.values(feed.near_earth_objects).flat();const valid=candidates.filter(a=>a?.id&&a?.name&&Array.isArray(a.close_approach_data)&&a.close_approach_data.length);if(!valid.length)throw new Error('No valid close-approach records');return [{json:{valid,rejected:candidates.length-valid.length,source:'NASA NeoWs'}}];

nodes.notes: Malformed records are rejected before publication; an empty valid set fails visibly.

nodes.name: Normalize Telemetry
nodes.notes: Creates the dashboard's stable, documented schema.

nodes.name: Calculate Deterministic Threat Index

parameters.jsCode: for(const a of $json.asteroids){const ld=a.miss_distance_km/384400,h=a.hazardous?25:0,p=ld<=1?35:ld<=5?28:ld<=20?18:ld<=100?8:2,d=a.diameter_meters>=1000?25:a.diameter_meters>=300?18:a.diameter_meters>=100?10:4,v=a.velocity_kmh>=100000?15:a.velocity_kmh>=60000?10:a.velocity_kmh>=30000?6:2,s=Math.min(100,h+p+d+v);a.threat_score=s;a.risk_factors={hazardous:h,proximity:p,diameter:d,velocity:v};a.risk_level=s>=75?'HIGH':s>=50?'ELEVATED':s>=25?'MODERATE':'LOW';a.assessment=`Automated assessment: ${a.risk_level} under the Prototype NEO Threat Index.`;}return $input.all();

nodes.notes: No AI decides risk. The formula is transparent and deterministic.
